easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
